events.name: River Revival 12: The Final Chapter
events.searchText: river revival 12 the final chapter what is river revival river revival the annual camping and independent music festival collaboration between splice records and saint arnold brewing company is the most accommodating and exciting festival in texas history with pristine campgrounds the mighty guadalupe and live music from all over texas our goal is to be the most fun music festival that does almost everything different from other events first off each admission includes an all inclusive ticket providing every attendee with the unique experience of not being continuously haggled by steep festival prices meals and camping are all included in the ticket price and please feel free to bring your own cooler and camping supplies with your admission we offer an impeccable food program amazing music live art installations and of course we have something most fest do not have the mighty guadalupe river where is river revival once again we are partnering with our favorite campgrounds kl ranch camp on the river and cliffside in new braunfels texas river revival is a great escape from city life as it stretches over 10 acres along the entire river front property the campsite price varies based on campsite amenities size and location on the grounds kl on the river the campsite address is 5455 river rd new braunfels tx 78132 check in for on the river passes and sites are located at this address kl cliffside 5300 river rd new braunfels tx 78132 check in for cliffside passes and sites are located at this address who attends river revival nature lovers music goers river rats camping enthusiasts foodies and festival followers make up the campgrounds we often hear back from our attendees that the campgrounds are filled with nice and very cool people families with children are more than welcome to attend children age 12 or under are free and do not count toward package capacity if you choose to bring your child we highly suggest you select a campsite between sites 70 to 60 on the river or cliffside as it is the furthest from live entertainment at any hour no unattended children after 8 00 pm you will also be required to sign a personal responsibility waiver at check in when is river revival we annually schedule the festival on the last full weekend of september as the river s peak season has ended and there are less people on the river the nights are a tad bit cooler allowing for good tent camping conditions and the river is ideal for when that texas sun gets high in the sky we also do our smaller half way to the revival event called river retreat on the last full weekend of march to learn more click here this year s river revival is scheduled for 4 days and 3 nights thursday september 24 through sunday sept 27 check in gates open at 1 00 pm on thursday 24th every pass and reservation is for all four days unless you buy a single day pass gates open at 1 00 pm on friday 25th and saturday 26th you can check in on thursday friday or saturday but it s the same price check in available until 10 00 pm unless you re bringing your own rv camper then please arrive no later than 5 00 pm attendees can stay as late as 12 00 pm on sunday september 27th river revival group packages available now the texas trident package 4 950 on the river only 4 available beginning thursday may 7th you can become the god or goddess of the guadalupe river with the texas trident package the sheer magnitude of this offering makes it our most comprehensive package available and we re proud to offer it for the third year in a row the texas trident is a mighty ideal way to experience river revival and is perfect for all marketing activations small business retreats large family vacations bachelor bachelorette party or as a generous client gift with the texas trident you will receive 10 x general admission passes 2 x on the river parking passes for your site prime campsite location a reserved table on the lawn seats 6 glamping experience upgrade with a premium rv camper sleeps 8 to 10 with a stocked fridge and mountains of swag waiting for you the campsite will have plenty of space for some of your group or add ons to tent camp as well splice the cost up between 10 people hint hint do the math the texas trident is the most platinum of premium packages river revival has ever offered which is why there are only 1 package available we handpick these premium site locations where your rv camper sleeps up to 8 will be waiting for your arrival and brimming with enough river revival swag for everyone not only do you get the be the envy of the campgrounds but you ll host and sit front row at our first full band amplified concert at the new cliffside stage the texas trident package comes with 10 general admission passes but you may add up to 8 more additional people to your campsite add x 1 general admission pass to site 18 total max there will be plenty of premium camping real estate at your campsite for your entire party to camp comfortably or to set up tents whether you re a business trying to make an impression or just a big group of friends splitting up cost of the coolest vip experience on the guadalupe the texas trident package has everything you need to maximize your good time river revival campsite reservation prices are rv campers not included general admission pass tent camping at on the river 375 electricity nearby and available general admission pass tent camping at cliffside 315 primitive but some campsites with access to electricity add 1 x general admission pass to a group package cliffside on the river 375 if you are purchasing a general admission pass to be added to a group package if you have purchased a group package and want additional general admission passes for your group package shared site packages including 2 general admission passes these packages are designed for parties of two people cliffside 650 tent camping electricity yes water no on the river 785 tent river electricity usb plugs rug flooring two chairs and two cots wake up each morning to the ducks gathering around and open the door to the riverbanks 1 395 single day passes are available for thursday friday and saturday 145 click here for geographical reference all camping is communal unless otherwise noted general admission amp group packages include four days three nights campsite all campsite reservations are thursday sunday and you can check in on thursday from 1 00 pm until 10 00 pm and at 1 00 pm until 10 00 pm on friday and saturday the event will be over around 1 00 pm sunday if you are bringing your own rv camper please do not arrive after 5 00 pm shuttle service for those needing a ride to and from cliffside we ve got you covered with state of the art golf carts and two kl cliffside buses the river revival shuttle service has pickup drop off locations at on the river and cliffside food program the steady bounty of nourishment served at river revival is top notch and a key ingredient to our all inclusive concept once again we ve partnered with little kitchen htx to provide brunch dinner snacks and late night munchies throughout the weekend on sunday little kitchen htx will be serving a bountiful brunch to pair with the final musical performance six meals included brunch friday saturday sunday and dinner thursday friday saturday all meals are communal brunch is around 10 00 am and dinner s around 6 00 pm even though your ticket is all inclusive all campers are welcome to bring their own food snacks beverages and supplies live entertainment thursday the main stage starts around 6 00 pm with the synergy one stage providing late night shows friday and saturday daytime music is designed to be viewed from your tube in the river while you float back and forth between the saint arnold brewing stage and the synergy one stage the evening concerts are on the lawn at the saint arnold brewing company main stage with the late night show taking place at the synergy one stage no amplified music allowed past 11 00 pm on the grounds or at your site be kind to your neighbors costume contests amp awards every night we ll highlight some of the best dressed in the crowd saturday night awards will be given out for the best dressed best hat best campsite best in float parade river couple of the weekend and of course the shoulda been at woodstock award custom wristband upon arrival and check in each attendee will receive a custom wristband granting access to food river music and more do not remove your wristband for the active hiking tubing morning yoga canoeing paddle boarding kayaking swimming rope swings and fishing showers the showers at on the river use tokens now and they are available at the merch booth cliffside still uses quarters and they are also available at the merch booth group package reservations come with an allotment of up to 4 people camping on your campsite except for the texas trident and where otherwise noted the texas trident package this package is designed for bachelor or bachelorette parties or for a group of friends that want to go big it comes with 10 all inclusive weekend passes you can add more a premium rv rental for all 4 days waiting on your site upon your arrival a stocked fridge and much much more there are four packages available for on the river price varies by location vendors sporting a wide range of vendors there s bound to be something that will catch your eye or to interact with such as clothing shops thrift stores bars and more add ons menu glamping experience upgrade 1 095 rent a camper rv from us that will be waiting for you on your site for you at kl ranch camp on the river or cliffside prices vary all campers come with beds bedding not included restroom heater ac kitchen fridge and they accommodate 4 6 people comfortably the campers have very limited supplies and you will need to bring your own bedding camping supplies cleaning supplies etc the rv campers are very limited and they sell out quickly for bigger parties refer to the super duper glamping experience upgrade or the texas trident package super duper glamping experience upgrade 1 495 this package is all about upgrading an upgrade this new addition to the menu has everything included in the glamping experience upgrade beds restroom heater ac kitchen fridge etc plus a larger rv camper that will accommodate 6 8 people comfortably more rooms more amenities more supplies and more special river magic you will not need to bring your own bedding but feel free to bring your camping supplies for even bigger party packages refer to the the texas trident package weekend tube rental 35 river retreat is offering a tube rental service at the merch booth they will be available to rent onsite but here is your opportunity to rent one ahead of the event a 35 deposit is taken at the merch booth when you come to pick up your tube rent yours in advance and pick it up when you arrive on the lawn on the river parking pass 150 to park onsite at kl on the river we require you to have an on the river parking pass otherwise there is plenty of free parking directly across the street parking pass not required for cliffside camping there will only be 20 in total sold this parking pass also allows you to sleep in your car there is no longer a separate sleeper parking pass option vip seating on the lawn with picnic table for you 195 reserve the best seat in the house with this picnic table seats 6 and umbrella upgrade your reservation begins each night at 5 00 pm just in time for the communal dinner and live music at the saint arnold brewing company stage cliffside or on the river golf cart concierge service 400 for cliffside or on the river sites 59 68 only are you one of the movers amp shakers that can t wait for a shuttle or golf cart to pick you up because there are so many wonderful things to do at river revival and you don t want to miss a single moment we feel your pain and prescribe for you the concierge service hey look we get it there s a lot to do and you don t want to wait nor should you the cliffside concierge service assigns your group your own personal golf cart driver to come get you and take you to your desired destination scheduled pick ups drop offs the service also provides supplies delivery to your campsite from the cliffside general store need ice beer sunscreen snacks just call the concierge of cliffside we also have some swag surprises and deliveries that comes with this service purchasing this add on covers your group of four people the stages saint arnold brewing company stage on the lawn river revival radio sponsors vendors food and fun and main stage live music the synergy one stage all day chill vibes river entrance for campground floating all weekend live music cold beer and the late late night parties as always we encourage you to express your awesomeness in fashion and decor camping information new rv camper rental policy this year we re handling all of the rv and camper rentals and providing onsite maintenance 9am 9pm in the past we allowed attendees to rent rv s and campers from third party vendors that would deliver the rv camper to kl campgrounds ahead of the attendee for myriad reasons this has become an untenable arrangement and this change should make the entire experience easier if you would like to rent an rv camper for the festival and have it delivered and waiting for you you must now use our glamping experience upgrade please select either the glamping experience add on or the new super duper glamping experience add on this policy change does not affect those attendees who own an rv camper and drive it onto the campgrounds themselves who have rented and picked up an rv camper and drive it onto the campgrounds themselves if you are bringing your own rv camper motorhome to revival please make sure you reserve a group package that has the proper 30 50 amp plugin options most rv sites have water but some do not and those sites are a bit smaller and cost less all the rv sites have 30 amp electrical plug ins most have water connections 50 amp sites are also available but limited generators are not welcome and we ask that all rv campers do not run their generator for power please note that one can reserve a 50 or 30 amp rv site and choose not to bring or use an rv motorhome camper you may simply pitch tents on the premium sites please read all descriptions you are welcome to setup as many tents as are necessary to accommodate your party only one rv camper per campsite permitted attendees who plan to tent camp will do so just like a regular camping weekend at kl ga passes on the river or cliffside will offer communal camping on shared sites so pack lightly as it is shared space and campsites all sites even if specified with 30 or 50 amps can be used for tent camping as well they just cost more due to upgraded amenities and there is plenty of tent camping that can also be done at cliffside and the price is right over there always cliffsideiscool clean and well maintained showers are available on site but they do require quarters for operation we will have numerous hand washing and hand sanitizer stations spread around the campgrounds as well as portable bathrooms everyone is encouraged to bring their own camping supplies food equipment coolers and beverages please feel free to cook on your campsite the campgrounds have firewood and ice on site for purchase there is also a small store on both campgrounds with various camping necessities should one forget or need something you can even buy cold beverages at the cliffside corner store stay tuned for fire ban information provided by comal county five of the seven years the fire ban was not in effect sorry campground rules not ours service dogs welcome please contact us about service dogs if you would like to volunteer for a shift and get a free t shirt and 50 off your pass click here for more information you will work 16 20 hours over the weekend and you will camp with all other volunteers click on the link to read about 20 things you need to know or bring to the river revival here little kitchen htx river revival not only features super talented performers on stage but also in the kitchen jason and becca kerr of little kitchen htx have spearheaded our all inclusive food program since 2018 as chef kerr describes it himself the river revival food program is an outdoor culinary experience dripping with nostalgia wielded in smoke and smothered in americana for all ages little kitchen htx takes the spirit of the texas river and revitalizes your soul with food cooked from the heart while chef kerr is known for his meat centric lowbrow take on american comfort food little kitchen htx provides vegetarian and vegan options for brunch and dinner each day check out his 2016 appearance on the chopped episode titled a bloody battle in the kitchen wherein jason kerr advances to the final round available on hulu river revival faq s q can i stay off site a yes you do not have to stay overnight your wristband allows you to leave the campgrounds and return please identify your wristband when you check back in at the box office q can i bring my own beverages and food a yes feel free to bring your own beverages and food the event is all inclusive but you can bring your own supplies q can i bring my own rv camper a yes you can but you must reserve a campsite that has the proper plug for your camper rv each site has different amenities so please read the descriptions q can i bring my rv camper and just run the generator a no we do not allow generators on the campsite because of the noise pollution q may i sleep in my car truck van a yes but you must purchase an on the river sleeper parking pass if you are planning on staying at kl on the river and sleeping in your vehicle at cliffside you do not have to buy a parking pass regardless of whether or not you re sleeping in your car q if i bought a cliffside pass do i need to check in at kl on the river a no we no longer require everyone to check in at on the river if you bought a site or a pass at cliffside then you can check in at cliffside this is a new policy that will continue for the foreseeable future q can i bring my own golf cart a no but you may contact the event first and request permission attendees who are older or have an issue walking will likely be granted permission please feel free to bring your bike w lights or an electric bike q is there shuttle service at cliffside a yes there is we have golf carts that are designed specifically for cliffside pick up and drop off and the campgrounds have van shuttle pick up and drop off as well pick up and drop off areas are clearly marked with signage on both campgrounds feel free to ask bobby or jennifer at cliffside for a ride or updates on the shuttle q can we have campfires a yes if there is no fire ban six out of nine years there has not been a fire ban q can we bring our own float a yes or you may rent one from us at the merch booth for the entire weekend q do you have a volunteer program a yes click here to sign up here once approved you will be sent a code to purchase a discounted ticket volunteers work 16 20 hours of light work over the weekend please note that if you are volunteering then we will account for your hours if you do not fulfill your obligation you will not be allowed to volunteer again new additions to river revival 1 improved shuttle service we ve added another bus to our transportation team the golf carts will be marked cliffside and they are for cliffside transportation only 2 payment plans if you would prefer to pay for river revival in 3 easy installments select the automated option during check out 3 to help reduce our environmental impact on the campgrounds and mother nature at large vendors will no longer be serving beverages in single use cups plastic or otherwise reusable souvenir cups will be available for purchase at the merch booth if you have your own reusable cup or canteen we will serve you 4 new saturday market at cliffside starting at 10 00 am on saturday the new market at cliffside will feature dozens of local vendors selling clothing jewelry plants river and camping gear food possibly real estate or even state secrets we re very excited about this addition to the festival and we re certain you will too 5 float parade friday the world famous river revival float parade has returned to friday at 2 30pm we get it sometimes it s a little tough getting organized on saturday morning at river revival so we ve moved the float parade to friday 6 new parking policy we will have very very limited parking at on the river because we are cutting off the road access from campsite 88 to 114 of on the river this means no parking spots or car access past campsite 88 you can buy the sleeper parking pass for on the river if you want to park at one of the designated parking spots at on the river 7 new rv camper rental policy 8 cliffside concierge service for cliffside only don t want to wait for a shuttle or golf cart to pick you up need ice beer sunscreen snacks the cliffside concierge service allows you to call for your personal golf cart to come get you and take you to your desired destination as well as provides supplies delivery to your campsite from the cliffside general store get a musical preview here volunteer program the river revival volunteer program allows us to offer a discounted general admission pass to the festival in exchange for working 16 hours with festival staff all volunteer signups must be approved once approved volunteers will receive a promo code allowing them to purchase their discounted general admission pass volunteer signup ends september 12 2026 anyone who does not fulfill their 16 hours will be required to pay the full ticket price or asked to leave the festival and will not be allowed to volunteer for future splice records events the volunteer programs will begin taking applications on june 18 application here volunteer camping is at cliffside this year campsites 30 32 upon arrival at the festival you will receive your karma krew t shirt krews available to work merch booth karma karts golf carts karma guides parking amp gates kitchen krew set up amp break down for more information email us or to sign up for the volunteer program click here the parking policy river revival s parking policy is designed to enhance the overall festival experience for all by opening up the campgrounds while also providing another level of safety and security beginning at 5pm on thursday at on the river the dirt road stretching from site 88 all the way to 114 and zen city starting at the turnaround near the restrooms will be closed to cars and trucks there is no parking available in this area unless you purchase the on the river parking pass free parking is available across river road at cliffside health amp safety protocols the health amp safety of all river revival attendees is of the highest importance to us which is why we will be following all guidelines and regulations set by the local and state governments state and local refunds there are no refunds for this event and please do not ask as always if you purchase a ticket and cannot attend you can transfer your reservation to a friend or family member if we have to cancel this event for any reason or postpone it for any reason we will offer everyone a 100 refund in conclusion we are very excited to bring river revival back to the kl campgrounds for the 12th and final time people who come to the revival often comment that our staff is kind learn that we love hospitality agree the event is well thought out and believe the river has healing powers and the worst thing they find out about the entire weekend is that it ends we hated that we waited 365 days to see everyone again so we created river retreat which is a smaller version of the river revival with a time warp twist to learn more about the retreat and splice records the record label behind all these magical events and some of the best music from the south click here river revival 2026 sponsors so far please become a sponsor by emailing us here for options deck and sponsor information the best way to experience the revival is as a sponsorship partner locomotion plaza reno nv us river revival festival

events.name: Mid-Autumn Family Festival
events.searchText: mid autumn family festival mooncakes lanterns and sweet reunions abound at moca s mid autumn family festival join us for crafts shadow puppets music games and more as we come together to celebrate this traditional holiday two sessions get your tickets for either the morning 10 am 1 pm or afternoon 2 pm 5 pm tickets 10 person kids 5 and under and moca family members free free tickets for kids 5 and under available as an add on option to your ticket purchase moca family members please use your code to access free tickets limited free tickets for culture pass and cool culture families sign up through the culture pass website or contact cool culture for your access code tickets may be purchased at the door on the day of the event starting at 10 30 am for the morning session and 2 30 pm for the afternoon session if capacity allows the museum of chinese in america is committed to making public programs accessible to the general public regardless of economic background if the ticket price is preventing you from attending the event please contact us check back shortly for the full schedule know before you go family festivals are bustling events with lots of sights sounds and aromas there is limited stroller parking available with a staff operated lift used to reach the restrooms and lower level spaces we recommend families with sensory concerns join our mocacreate events to celebrate the holiday due to the limited capacity of the museum and efforts to adhere to safety guidelines families may have to wait to enter the museum during peak times festival schedule performances workshops amp activities moonlit melodies with musician wei sun join musician wei sun in learning about one of the world s oldest string instruments the guzheng enjoy a live performance inspired by the beauty of the season s harvest moon about wei sunwei sun is an acclaimed guzheng artist from china who was born into a family of musicians and started her guzheng journey at the age of 6 she is a certified senior teacher of guzheng a member of the china national instrumental association and the international guzheng association in 2016 she came to the united states as a guzheng performer and teacher at the cba cultural and arts center chinese theatre works presents tiger tales shadow puppet performance during the mid autumn festival shadow puppetry is especially popular because the full moon acts as a natural light source for performances join chinese theatre works as they bring to life an enchanting tale where a wise old rabbit recounts stories from her eventful life to her young granddaughter including how she came to be the prime minister to tiger the ever hungry jungle king all ages about chinese theatre workschinese theatre works ctw has a long history of bringing traditional and innovative contemporary chinese performing arts to local new york city national and international audiences the company has won the highest honor in u s puppetry a citation of excellence from unima usa for their show toy theater peony pavilion they have also been featured at festivals and conferences across the world from puppet power in calgary canada and the seattle international children s theatre festival to the dala festival seoul south korea and the taipei children s theater association s festival taiwan mocakids author meet amp greet with michele wong mcsweenbe among the first to celebrate the newest gordon amp li li bilingual book celebrate mid autumn festival join author michele wong mcsween for an interactive bilingual adventure featuring storytelling a fun introduction to mandarin and hands on activities children and families will discover the legendary story of hou yi chang e and the jade rabbit while exploring the traditions special foods and joy of celebrating under the bright full moon books and plushies will be available for purchase and a book signing with michele will follow the reading best for families with children ages 3 8 younger and older siblings welcome about michele wong mcsweenmichele wong mcsween a former fashion designer mom and author of gordon amp li li began a journey to reconnect with her chinese heritage as a fourth generation chinese american inspired by her children michele enrolled them in mandarin classes to foster a sense of cultural identity while seeking simple and engaging mandarin learning materials for non chinese speaking families she discovered a lack of resources and was inspired to fill that gap this led her to create gordon amp li li a bilingual book series that makes learning mandarin approachable and fun michele is deeply committed to representing multicultural families and fostering a connection to chinese culture through language snowy skin mooncake making with auntie lin sharing mooncakes with friends and family is a beloved mid autumn tradition join auntie lin as she shows us how to make special snowy skin mooncakes discover the ingredients inside mooncakes and the molds used to make them and then eat a no bake mooncake that you make yourself munching on mooncakes mooncake tasting station try delectable slices of traditional mooncakes courtesy of po wing hong food market and fay da bakery shoot for the moon scavenger hunt join a moca educator in following clues high and low to spot twinkling full moons and shimmering stars in the museum exhibits practice your archery like hou yi to protect the galleries mocakids storytime to the moon and back did you know that a goddess rabbit and woodcutter all live on the moon join moca educator nancy in learning all about enchanting chang e and the timeless traditions of the moon festival mid autumn games hou yi s sun toss be a hero like hou yi toss bean bags to shoot down nine of the ten suns and save the earth from drought timber wu gang wood cutting challenge chinese legend says that a man on the moon is trying to cut down a tree that magically regrows after each ax stroke test your aim and your tree cutting skills with a moca original game can you succeed where wu gang couldn t bo bing roll the dice and celebrate the moon during the mid autumn festival in southern china families and friends gather to play bo bing a lively dice game that s all about luck laughter and togetherness take turns rolling the dice to win special prizes bunny hop hop your way through a mid autumn picnic filled with all your favorite festival treats mooncakes pomelo lotus root and so many more each hop brings you closer to a joyful celebration under the full moon mooncake matching harvest moon picnicthe full harvest moon symbolizes family reunion and coming together gather around the blanket for a make believe harvest moon picnic learn about the foods that families share as they gaze at the moon and give thanks for the year s harvest add your own favorite treat to our community picnic using scratch art and a little imagination mid autumn memories photo cornersoak up the limelight or moonlight at our mid autumn photo corner strike a pose with moon goddess chang e skilled archer hou yi yutu the jade rabbit and special moon themed props calligraphy corner with the new york chinese cultural center 2 4 pm afternoon only use your best brushstrokes to write the chinese character yuebing or mooncake with teaching artist angela from the new york chinese cultural center about the new york chinese cultural center nyccc is dedicated to deepening the understanding and appreciation of chinese culture in the global and local communities founded in 1974 by artists and community leaders in chinatown nyccc offers performances workshops and classes in chinese performing and visual arts art forms include chinese dance lion dance music kung fu tai chi calligraphy ink brush painting lantern making and others nyccc preserves traditional chinese arts for current and future generations to enjoy drop in arts amp crafts powerful potionsprepare your own version of the magical elixir that lifted chang e from the earth to the moon grind salt and colorful chalk to create sparkling colorful sand then use it to fill a potion bottle and stir up some mid autumn magic moonlight magic wandsdesign your own sparkling moon wand to celebrate the mid autumn festival fill it with shimmering sequins and watch it catch light like the moon in the night sky mid autumn moonscapesusing markers foil and a splash of water make your own mid autumn moonscape to celebrate the season s fullest brightest moon experiment with color and texture to capture the moon s changing beauty through the seasons spectacular shadow storiesconstruct and decorate shadow puppets of the jade rabbit and moon goddess chang e using acetate paper fasteners markers and more when you finish your creation head to moca s shadow puppet theater to stage an original performance make believe mooncakes mooncakes come in countless shapes sizes amp patterns explore intricate mooncake designs pick your favorite and mold a clay mooncake of your using real mooncake molds mooncake messages with teaching artist yu rong mooncakes are delicious and revolutionary during the yuan dynasty they were used to pass secret messages which helped overthrow the mongolian empire in china using our homemade invisible ink write and decode your very own secret messages and riddles about yu rong yu rong is a new york based multidisciplinary artist and educator whose practice bridges eastern and western artistic traditions working across a range of media she has exhibited internationally at venues including milan design week london design fair ceres gallery in new york and arc gallery in chicago yu serves as a teaching artist at the museum of chinese in america and leads creative workshops for organizations such as microsoft google and columbia university space is limited while supplies last moca s family festival series is supported in part by an award from the events.searchText: mid autumn family festival mooncakes lanterns and sweet reunions abound at moca s mid autumn family festival join us for crafts shadow puppets music games and more as we come together to celebrate this traditional holiday two sessions get your tickets for either the morning 10 am 1 pm or afternoon 2 pm 5 pm tickets 10 person kids 5 and under and moca family members free free tickets for kids 5 and under available as an add on option to your ticket purchase moca family members please use your code to access free tickets limited free tickets for culture pass and cool culture families sign up through the culture pass website or contact cool culture for your access code tickets may be purchased at the door on the day of the event starting at 10 30 am for the morning session and 2 30 pm for the afternoon session if capacity allows the museum of chinese in america is committed to making public programs accessible to the general public regardless of economic background if the ticket price is preventing you from attending the event please contact us check back shortly for the full schedule know before you go family festivals are bustling events with lots of sights sounds and aromas there is limited stroller parking available with a staff operated lift used to reach the restrooms and lower level spaces we recommend families with sensory concerns join our mocacreate events to celebrate the holiday due to the limited capacity of the museum and efforts to adhere to safety guidelines families may have to wait to enter the museum during peak times festival schedule performances workshops amp activities moonlit melodies with musician wei sun join musician wei sun in learning about one of the world s oldest string instruments the guzheng enjoy a live performance inspired by the beauty of the season s harvest moon about wei sunwei sun is an acclaimed guzheng artist from china who was born into a family of musicians and started her guzheng journey at the age of 6 she is a certified senior teacher of guzheng a member of the china national instrumental association and the international guzheng association in 2016 she came to the united states as a guzheng performer and teacher at the cba cultural and arts center chinese theatre works presents tiger tales shadow puppet performance during the mid autumn festival shadow puppetry is especially popular because the full moon acts as a natural light source for performances join chinese theatre works as they bring to life an enchanting tale where a wise old rabbit recounts stories from her eventful life to her young granddaughter including how she came to be the prime minister to tiger the ever hungry jungle king all ages about chinese theatre workschinese theatre works ctw has a long history of bringing traditional and innovative contemporary chinese performing arts to local new york city national and international audiences the company has won the highest honor in u s puppetry a citation of excellence from unima usa for their show toy theater peony pavilion they have also been featured at festivals and conferences across the world from puppet power in calgary canada and the seattle international children s theatre festival to the dala festival seoul south korea and the taipei children s theater association s festival taiwan mocakids author meet amp greet with michele wong mcsweenbe among the first to celebrate the newest gordon amp li li bilingual book celebrate mid autumn festival join author michele wong mcsween for an interactive bilingual adventure featuring storytelling a fun introduction to mandarin and hands on activities children and families will discover the legendary story of hou yi chang e and the jade rabbit while exploring the traditions special foods and joy of celebrating under the bright full moon books and plushies will be available for purchase and a book signing with michele will follow the reading best for families with children ages 3 8 younger and older siblings welcome about michele wong mcsweenmichele wong mcsween a former fashion designer mom and author of gordon amp li li began a journey to reconnect with her chinese heritage as a fourth generation chinese american inspired by her children michele enrolled them in mandarin classes to foster a sense of cultural identity while seeking simple and engaging mandarin learning materials for non chinese speaking families she discovered a lack of resources and was inspired to fill that gap this led her to create gordon amp li li a bilingual book series that makes learning mandarin approachable and fun michele is deeply committed to representing multicultural families and fostering a connection to chinese culture through language snowy skin mooncake making with auntie lin sharing mooncakes with friends and family is a beloved mid autumn tradition join auntie lin as she shows us how to make special snowy skin mooncakes discover the ingredients inside mooncakes and the molds used to make them and then eat a no bake mooncake that you make yourself munching on mooncakes mooncake tasting station try delectable slices of traditional mooncakes courtesy of po wing hong food market and fay da bakery shoot for the moon scavenger hunt join a moca educator in following clues high and low to spot twinkling full moons and shimmering stars in the museum exhibits practice your archery like hou yi to protect the galleries mocakids storytime to the moon and back did you know that a goddess rabbit and woodcutter all live on the moon join moca educator nancy in learning all about enchanting chang e and the timeless traditions of the moon festival mid autumn games hou yi s sun toss be a hero like hou yi toss bean bags to shoot down nine of the ten suns and save the earth from drought timber wu gang wood cutting challenge chinese legend says that a man on the moon is trying to cut down a tree that magically regrows after each ax stroke test your aim and your tree cutting skills with a moca original game can you succeed where wu gang couldn t bo bing roll the dice and celebrate the moon during the mid autumn festival in southern china families and friends gather to play bo bing a lively dice game that s all about luck laughter and togetherness take turns rolling the dice to win special prizes bunny hop hop your way through a mid autumn picnic filled with all your favorite festival treats mooncakes pomelo lotus root and so many more each hop brings you closer to a joyful celebration under the full moon mooncake matching harvest moon picnicthe full harvest moon symbolizes family reunion and coming together gather around the blanket for a make believe harvest moon picnic learn about the foods that families share as they gaze at the moon and give thanks for the year s harvest add your own favorite treat to our community picnic using scratch art and a little imagination mid autumn memories photo cornersoak up the limelight or moonlight at our mid autumn photo corner strike a pose with moon goddess chang e skilled archer hou yi yutu the jade rabbit and special moon themed props calligraphy corner with the new york chinese cultural center 2 4 pm afternoon only use your best brushstrokes to write the chinese character yuebing or mooncake with teaching artist angela from the new york chinese cultural center about the new york chinese cultural center nyccc is dedicated to deepening the understanding and appreciation of chinese culture in the global and local communities founded in 1974 by artists and community leaders in chinatown nyccc offers performances workshops and classes in chinese performing and visual arts art forms include chinese dance lion dance music kung fu tai chi calligraphy ink brush painting lantern making and others nyccc preserves traditional chinese arts for current and future generations to enjoy drop in arts amp crafts powerful potionsprepare your own version of the magical elixir that lifted chang e from the earth to the moon grind salt and colorful chalk to create sparkling colorful sand then use it to fill a potion bottle and stir up some mid autumn magic moonlight magic wandsdesign your own sparkling moon wand to celebrate the mid autumn festival fill it with shimmering sequins and watch it catch light like the moon in the night sky mid autumn moonscapesusing markers foil and a splash of water make your own mid autumn moonscape to celebrate the season s fullest brightest moon experiment with color and texture to capture the moon s changing beauty through the seasons spectacular shadow storiesconstruct and decorate shadow puppets of the jade rabbit and moon goddess chang e using acetate paper fasteners markers and more when you finish your creation head to moca s shadow puppet theater to stage an original performance make believe mooncakes mooncakes come in countless shapes sizes amp patterns explore intricate mooncake designs pick your favorite and mold a clay mooncake of your using real mooncake molds mooncake messages with teaching artist yu rong mooncakes are delicious and revolutionary during the yuan dynasty they were used to pass secret messages which helped overthrow the mongolian empire in china using our homemade invisible ink write and decode your very own secret messages and riddles about yu rong yu rong is a new york based multidisciplinary artist and educator whose practice bridges eastern and western artistic traditions working across a range of media she has exhibited internationally at venues including milan design week london design fair ceres gallery in new york and arc gallery in chicago yu serves as a teaching artist at the museum of chinese in america and leads creative workshops for organizations such as microsoft google and columbia university space is limited while supplies last moca s family festival series is supported in part by an award from the national endowment for the arts with public funds from the new york city department of cultural affairs in partnership with the city council and with public funds from the new york state council on the arts with the support of governor kathy hochul and the new york state legislature to find out more about how national endowment for the arts grants impact individuals and communities visit www events.name: Damien Jurado with St. Yuma
events.searchText: damien jurado with st yuma play on theres no such thing as better days damien jurado sings on roger the sweeping wash of a song that opens reggae film star his 18th full length album and second release from jurados own maraqopa records label but as he enters his 25th year as a recording artist its clear these are at the least very good days for jurado on the creative front in these 12 songs which evoke half recalled dreams and overheard conversations the cosmic rushes headlong into the autobiographical and specific moments on the clock fade from past to future to scenes set only in the eternal now playing out like a backlot documentary filmed on the location of an unnamed tv or film setmaybe a sitcom taping or perhaps its a low budget science fiction b movie or could it be a talk show the album is populated by performers awaiting call times camera operators praying for their shot and studio audiences rapt with anticipation the stars here eschew glitz and glamor instead they wander grocery stores and parking lots in the verdant pacific northwest and the desert southwest looking for payphones and a sense of purpose produced by jurado with multi instrumentalist josh gordon and recording engineer alex bush at sonikwire studio in irvine ca jurados home away from home and musical headquarters the records compositions are among the most musically rich in his vast discography encompassing romantic am gold 60s psychedelia driving rock s unmistakable voice at once intimately present and ghostly grounded in the here and now but capable at any moment of drifting off into the divinatory following threads established by 2021s the monster who hated pennsylvania the album sees jurado embracing his auteur era penning vignettes that arrive with little fanfare and depart quicker than you might suspect only to linger long after they wrap seeking a skeleton key to decipher the action is beside the pointjurados songs are worlds meant to be lived in not picked apartbut on the beatific single what happened to the class of 65 the singer imagines himself as both the viewer and the viewed the eye behind the camera and its subject this emotional and spiritual transference animates reggae film star like a masterful director jurado offers motivation to the listener staring unblinkingly from the mise en scne in your mind look into the camera he commands on the day of the robot one more time with anger and sadness i believe you a quarter century in jurado remains gripped by his visions and driven by an unmatched creative drive reggae film star is one of damien jurados finest works to date a stunning new feature from one of indie rocks most cinematic figures here on this sound stage you are the camera you are the scene you are the setting and you are the viewer please try not to blink jason p woodbury gasa gasa new orleans la us damien jurado

events.name: HENRY CARPENDER live in the SIDEBAR!
events.searchText: henry carpender live in the sidebar fitzgeralds sidebar presents henry carpender quintet free show reservation available henry carpender is a trombonist composer and educator based in the city of chicago an artist who is equally informed by his classical training love of jazz and childhood playing rock music primarily with his father john carpender henry s playing and writing is a charming blend of punchy sensitive quirky and dripping with love for life and self expression henry s dedication to music making began at age 13 when he played his first gig with the much beloved local band expo 76 since then through both his education and the beginning of his professional freelance career henry has been fortunate enough to share the stage with dag juhlin billy harper robbie fulks tanya darby cathy richardson nrbq and the canadian brass henry has also enjoyed a healthy start to a career as a private instructor and group music educator running a small studio of dedicated middle and high schoolers across the chicagoland area when he s not playing or teaching he can be found playing video games cooking a new dish or relaxing on montrose beach this show will be an opportunity to premiere new work revisit some favorites and share arrangements of some of henry s favorite artists rufus parenti on the tenor saxophone jesse lear on upright bass and tommy sagins on drums cymbals grab dinner before the show at babygold barbecue parking there is rather limited street parking in the area we recommend arriving by rideshare bicycle or rickshaw age restrictions all ages fitzgeralds sidebar berwyn il us

events.name: ROBERT ELLIS Band at FITZGERALDS w/ special guest Philip Bowen
events.searchText: robert ellis band at fitzgeralds w special guest philip bowen fitzgeralds nightclub presents robert ellis at fitzgeralds nightclub w special guest philip bowen 25 general admission reserved tables available recorded live to tape in just two days robert ellis s exquisite new album yesterday s news is as stripped down as it gets with the celebrated songwriter and producer s delicate reedy tenor accompanied only by nylon string guitar upright bass and the occasional piece of handheld percussion the arrangements are harmonically sophisticated here drawing on the open tunings and intricate fingerpicking of english songwriters like nick drake or richard thompson and ellis s performances are similarly subtle and nuanced tapping into the bittersweet longing of chet baker and the playful poignancy of bill evans and jim hall while that might seem surprising coming off 2019 s raucous texas piano man subverting expectations is nothing new for ellis born and raised outside houston he gained early acclaim for his piercing introspection and absorbing narratives but over the course of five solo albums he flirted with everything from paul simon and john prine to elton john and joni mitchell in a series of sonic and visual transformations that ran the gamut from redneck steely dan to lone star liberace npr hailed his rdquo musical daring and impeccable songcraft while rolling stone praised his rdquo sharp eye for storytelling and the new york times lauded his writing as an emotional rdquo gut punch yesterday s news marks ellis s debut lp for niles city records an outgrowth of the famed niles city sound studio he and longtime collaborator josh block run in fort worth tx grab dinner before the show at babygold barbecue link to restaurant website or enjoy full service dining inside the club when doors open parking there is rather limited street parking in the area we recommend arriving by rideshare bicycle or rickshaw age restrictions 21 minors admitted with guardian fitzgeralds nightclub berwyn il us robert ellis

events.searchText: acid bath with high on fire melvins windhand quarry ampitheater at uc santa cruz carved from a former limestone quarry in the 1960 s the historic quarry amphitheater located at the heart of the uc santa cruz campus reopened after a major renovation in october 2017 welcoming its first ever night time concert with la based rockers chicano batman with a deep history of hosting legendary artists activists and authors including angela davis ravi shankar alfred hitchcock and cesar chavez the quarry has reopened as a critical gathering space to celebrate live music and community referred to as the rdquo red rocks in the redwoods the quarry is the largest outdoor venue with an existing stage and seating in the greater santa cruz community the quarry amphitheater s unique terraced asymmetrical design allows for amazing sight lines and multiple venue configurations from open floor to reserved seating layouts at a maximum capacity of 2600 the quarry now holds the opportunity to become the region s premiere outdoor destination concert venue while also retaining its value as a natural open space more information https www quarryamphitheater com on site parking 20 per car which includes shuttle to the venue parking tickets are not sold in advance quarry amphitheater santa cruz ca us high on fire melvins windhand

is a modern day troubadour a canadian artist defined by his authenticity and adventurous spirit guitar in hand and a grin on his face jesse along with long time bandmates the pretty good band has spent much of the last few years travelling the highways byways and backroads of north america bringing his own brand of modern indie infused americana blues to fervent audiences across the continent known for his powerhouse live performances jesse is truly electrifying on stage his soulful vocals expanding across silky guitars and hard hitting grooves you d never guess that this soldier of the six string all mischief mayhem and virtuoso guitar playing experienced crippling stage fright long into his 20s today the stage is his home and he s inviting you in cold one in hand for one helluva good time of course he s more than a magnetising stage presence and great hair jesse has the goods to back this up a master at connecting his personal experiences to his songwriting he crafts wildly entertaining narratives of the challenges and eccentricities of life pulling inspiration from all that surrounds him his musings on love both won and lost the call of the road and the promise of what s round the corner draw similarities to jj cale leon bridges and alabama shakes his innate musical talent and flexibility of style have seen him play with soul icon booker t jones rock veteran colin james blues belter beth hart and canadian legend burton cummings across streaming platforms he s racked up over 500 000 monthly listeners and millions of streams while based in victoria bc jesse is back on the road with the pretty good band throughout 2026 all seasoned musicians themselves the band is matt reid bass chris van sickle keys east coast pete guitar and brent norman drums rdquo each one of these guys on their own is funnier and smarter than i am but somehow i m the band leader jesse laughs rdquo i m a lucky lead guy to have these cats in my band they re pretty good grab dinner events.searchText: alicia blue at fitzgeralds nightclub fitzgeralds nightclub presents alicia blue at fitzgeralds nightclub 20 general admission reserved tables available alicia blues path to music didnt follow a straight line born along the san bernardinoline in california and raised between southern california and south texas she grew upbetween cultures rhythms and storiesmariachi on her dads stereo west coast soulin her headphones and notebooks full of poetry in her backpack music wasnt the plan but life had other ideas a chance run in with an aging soul singer changed everythinghe saw something in her and she leaned in the poems turned into songs and theguitarbarely more than a few chords at the timebecame her tool for survival andconnection she played her first open mic in 2016 armed with heart and raw talent just a few yearslater magma one of her earliest songs landed on starbucks flagship spotify playlistand played in stores around the world word started to spread there was somethingdifferent about this voice honest haunting unafraid by 2020 alicia had carved out a name for herself in las songwriter scene blendingamericana folk and alt country with an emotional depth that felt both timeless andrefreshingly current a brief trip to nashville in 2021 to write with some local legendsturned into a full blown relocation the following spring it didnt take long for her to findher peopleand her placein music city in 2024 she released a run of powerful singles including tennessee a soul stirringduet with lucinda williams that garnered critical buzz and introduced alicia to a wholenew audience by 2025 her sound had evolved again digging deeper into the classiccountry she grew up on colored by the mariachi melodies her mexican father onceplayed for her think dolly meets emmylou with a little waylon at the edges now alicias gearing up to record her debut country album with none other than shooterjennings whos called her the voice of a generation and as rare as they come withnew music on the horizon label talks in motion and a voice that feels both familiar andcompletely her own alicia blue is poised for a breakout yearand shes just gettingstarted grab spooktacular premiere at luminary arts center minneapolis mn this halloween weekend leo presents invites audiences to experience a breathtaking new production of the hunchback of notre dame silent film with live orchestra at luminary arts center in minneapolis s north loop home to the minnesota opera and other acclaimed acts luminary arts center will serve as the stage for this extraordinary cinematic concert featuring the 1923 universal studios monster silent film crafted by local composer philip shorey the production combines an original score with an international 50 piece orchestra choral ensemble renaissance band theatrical special effects and a rock n roll inspired light show based on victor hugo s timeless 1831 gothic novel the hunchback of notre dame tells the story of quasimodo the bell ringer of notre dame cathedral and his enduring love for the beautiful dancer esmeralda set against the tragic backdrop of 15th century paris this dark romance explores themes of compassion prejudice heroism and virtue this immersive presentation brings new life to a beloved story combining the power of orchestral performance with the magic of cinema shorey has built an international reputation for reimagining classic silent films for modern audiences his productions have headlined major music festivals and sold out concert halls throughout europe and the united states this halloween marks his return to minneapolis for the world premiere of his latest original work the hunchback of notre dame audience attire guests are encouraged to embrace the spirit of the evening by dressing in their favorite renaissance inspired costume attire parking convenient event parking is available directly across the street from the venue for 6 making for an easy and enjoyable night out in minneapolis s vibrant north loop district street parking is also free after 6pm luminary arts center minneapolis mn us

events.name: CHARLIE PARR: Rooming House Record Release w/ special guest Ross Thorn!
events.searchText: charlie parr rooming house record release w special guest ross thorn fitzgeralds nightclub presents charlie parr rooming house record release show at fitzgeralds w special guest ross thorn rolling stone has called charlie parr s music rdquo a gritty blend of delta blues and depression era roots music soaked in his hardscrabble voice it s a sacred realm of folk wisdom and sorrowful vulnerability npr said he offers rdquo expertly picked resonator guitar and lyrics that puncture the soul parr tours prolifically and has performed at tastemaker events like the newport folk fest and pickathon the duluth based guitarist songwriter and interpreter of traditional music has released twenty albums over two and a half decades and has been known to perform up to 275 shows a year parr is a folk troubadour in the truest sense taking to the road between shows writing and rewriting songs as he plays fueled by a belief that music is eternal and cannot be claimed or adequately explained the sounds from his working class upbringing including folkways legends such as lead belly and woody guthrie imbue parr s music with stylistic echoes of blues and folk icons of decades past parr sees himself merely as a continuer of a folk tradition parr s mastery of his craft is only more apparent when contextualized within the history of folk tradition to which parr has dedicated his practice the land and lives around and intersecting with parr have always influenced him from the hills and valleys of hollandale minnesota to the depression era stories from his father parr s first album with smithsonian folkways last of the better days ahead 2021 foregrounded his lyrical craftsmanship and sophisticated bluesman confidence with spare production highlighting parr s mastery of guitar and elevating his blues poetry in his 2024 release little sun parr weaved together stories celebrating music community and communing with nature in doing so he put forth an ambitious and raw album that exemplifies the best of parr s sound his blend of the blues and folk traditions with the steadfast originality of a poet now he continues that tradition with 2026 s poignant and timely rooming house which joins the chorus of wpa era socially conscious folk operas and outlaw country concept albums of the 1970s to poignantly allegorize his experiences and the experiences of the people around him grab dinner before the show at babygold barbecue or enjoy full service dining inside the club when doors open parking there is rather limited street parking in the area we recommend arriving by rideshare bicycle or rickshaw age restrictions 21 minors admitted with guardian fitzgeralds nightclub berwyn il us charlie parr

events.name: FRANK CATALANO Celebrates Eddie Harris!
events.searchText: frank catalano celebrates eddie harris fitzgeralds nightclub presents frank catalano celebrates eddie harris swiss movement cold duck time exodus to jazz freedom jazz dance 25 general admission seat reserved tables available legendary saxman frank catalano consistently headlines world class festivals and sells out venues throughout the usa europe and japan thanks to his signature sound and renowned reputation catalano averages 150 concerts a year with his jazz quartet as a coveted guest artist frank often lends his sax stylings to high profile rock groups recent highlights include playing a 7 minute improvised sax solo at the hollywood bowl with the smashing pumpkins closing out the chicago blues festival with los lobos and performing with les claypool sean lennon and the violent femmes he also teamed up on a unique version of the janes addiction hit jane says with perry farrell billy corgan and jimmy chamberlin franks longtime friend and collaborator eddie harris was born october 20 1934 in chicago illinois he began his career as a singer in various baptist churches throughout chicago around the age of 3 eddies cousin bernice benson who played piano at eddies mothers church began teaching him how to play the piano where he learned to play by ear and eventually learned to read music eddie learned to play the clarinet vibraphone and saxophone while attending dusable high school in chicago illinois under the guidance of a well known and influential musical director captain walter dyett captain dyett was responsible for the development of several jazz musicians who came out of chicago from the 1940s to the early 1960s eddie always wanted to play the saxophone simply because he admired the way it looked however in order to play saxophone for captain dyett one had to play the clarinet first so eddies first wind instrument was the clarinet grab dinner before the show at babygold barbecueor enjoy full service dining inside the events.searchText: them coulee boys final tour fitzgeralds nightclub fitzgeralds nightclub presents them coulee boys seen here 30 general admission 40 seat reserved tablessoren staff and beau janke co founders of folk rock americana outfit them coulee boys met as camp counselors in northern wisconsin in 2011 their weekend workshopping of avett brothers and classic country tunes led to original songs and adding sorens brother jens on mandolin as the years grew the band turned into a more rollicking outfit adding neil krause on electric bass and stas hable on drums the bands name is a nod to the glacial melt carved river valleys they call home known by early french fur trappers as coulees known for wild swings of emotion during sets it is not unusual to see fans in tears and minutes later dancing with abandon the honesty and ability to talk and sing about the feelings and emotions that shape them has endeared them to a growing group of fans and friends with four full length albums and an ep behind them including 2019s die happy produced bytrampled by turtles dave simonett on lo hi records and 2021s namesake produced by grammy winner brian joseph the band has garnered international attention and earned press in american songwriter ditty tv folk alley and the bluegrass situation as well as tours with trampled by turtles los lobos old crow medicine show and a spot on the songwriters cayamo cruise 2021s namesake found the band following a new trajectory combining their signature take on folk grass and americana with comfort on electric instruments and playing rock and roll the record lives and breathes its both intimate and bombastic its the sweet aunt who makes delicious pies and the wiley uncle whos not afraid to hit a bit of the bottle at the bottom is the acceptance that comes with family and old friends none of us are perfect but theres enough love out there to make up for it in 2020 they were named milwaukee journal sentinels band to watch in 2021 they won bluegrass americana band of the year by the wisconsin area music industry for all things them coulee boys please visit themcouleeboys com grab dinner before the show at babygold barbecueor events.name: CRAIG FINN & The Band of Forgiveness @ FITZGERALDS NIGHTCLUB
events.searchText: craig finn the band of forgiveness fitzgeralds nightclub fitzgeralds nightclub presents craig finn the band of forgiveness 42 general admission seated 50 seat reserved tables fully seated show craig finn is a minnesota bred singer songwriter based in new york city best known as the singer of the hold steady finn spent the 90s leading minneapolis indie band lifter puller which released 3 albums and an ep after relocating to new york he joined with lifter puller member tad kubler to form the hold steady in 2003 the hold steady quickly achieved critical acclaim and a worldwide fanbase with their unique pairing of dense lyrical narratives with big rock guitars the hold steadys ninth album the price of progress was released in march 2023 commemorating the bands 20th anniversary craig finn released his 6th solo album always been in 2025 produced by adam granduciel the war on drugs the album features musical performances by granduciel and members of the war on drugs kathleen edwards sam fender and more always been tells the story of a man who becomes a clergyman despite a lack of faith the songs detail his rise fall and eventual redemption while also shining a light to sharply reveal the other characters that populate the world he moves through a limited edition 92 page companion book lousy with ghosts accompanies the album and features 11 works of fiction by craig finn these stories take place in the same universe as the record giving deeper looks at the characters within finn released his first solo album in 2012 with three additional solo lps put forth from 2015 2019 faith in the future we all want the same things and 2019s i need a new war which coalesced into a sign of the times musical trilogy finns fifth album a legacy of rentals was released in 2022 and received universal critical acclaim in 2025 finn debuted the band of forgiveness an accomplished group of minneapolis based musicians who bring a unique musical perspective to finns solo compositions in early 2026 the band of forgiveness toured the uk culminating in a sold out performance at londons esteemed union chapel thats how i remember it is craig finns podcast series launched in 2022 co produced and distributed by talkhouse the podcast series examines the connection between memory and creativity each episode features a discussion between finn and one creator including musicians authors filmmakers and more about the role memory plays in their art these exclusive conversations reveal the different ways each creator synthesizes their remembered life experience to tell stories about themselves and the world we live in podcast guests have included george saunders fred armisen bill hader lucinda williams johnny marr jason isbell duff mckagan adam duritz ben gibbard and many more grab dinner before the show at babygold barbecueor enjoy full service dining inside the club when doors open parking there is rather limited street parking in the area we recommend arriving by rideshare bicycle or rickshaw age restrictions 21 minors admitted with guardian fitzgeralds nightclub berwyn il us craig finn

outfit quickly made a name for itself through energetic house parties and dynamic live shows led by the captivating vocals of frontwoman monique powell without a record label powell managed the band herself during its early days their big break came when legendary kroq dj rodney bingenheimer played their cover of dexys midnight runners rdquo come on eileen the overwhelming listener response landed them in heavy radio rotation and caught the attention of major labels in 1996 after winning a grammy showcase for best unsigned band save ferris signed with epic records they released their debut album it means everything in 1997 featuring rdquo come on eileen alongside original hits the band toured internationally for years before releasing 1999 s modified and eventually going on hiatus in 2003 during the break powell worked as a sought after studio musician contributing vocals for artists like the used and goldfinger however severe health issues culminated in a high risk 2015 spinal surgery that threatened her vocal cords spurred by a promise to her father powell successfully recovered and reformed save ferris with a fresh lineup the revived band returned triumphantly playing massive sold out shows and releasing the 2016 crowdfunded ep checkered past produced by oingo boingo s john avila they followed up with a headlining spot on the 2017 warped tour proving their staying power on stage today save ferris continues to captivate audiences with infectious energy and powell s magnetic stage presence rejecting the label of a simple nostalgia act the band is actively working on their first full length album in over two decades proving their best days are still ahead ticket 35 45 club policies show 6 30pm 9pm doors 5pm 8 30pm seating is first come first served per section 20 minimum per person full bar dinner menu available no refunds or exchanges tickets will be delivered 48 hours prior to the showtime please ensure you purchase tickets for the correct date and time when all available bar seats are occupied the remaining bar area is standing room only table seating is all ages bar area is 21 important note we are not affiliated with any third party ticket sellers tickets purchased directly through our official website or ticketweb are the only authorized sources group reservations groups of 6 or more that want to sit together must purchase a group package at events bluenotehawaii com parking validated parking available at outrigger paradise entrance located on kuhio ave 6 for up to 4 hours of parking blue note hawaii honolulu hi us save ferris

seated show craig finn is a minnesota bred singer songwriter based in new york city best known as the singer of the hold steady finn spent the 90s leading minneapolis indie band lifter puller which released 3 albums and an ep after relocating to new york he joined with lifter puller member tad kubler to form the hold steady in 2003 the hold steady quickly achieved critical acclaim and a worldwide fanbase with their unique pairing of dense lyrical narratives with big rock guitars the hold steadys ninth album the price of progress was released in march 2023 commemorating the bands 20th anniversary craig finn released his 6th solo album always been in 2025 produced by adam granduciel the war on drugs the album features musical performances by granduciel and members of the war on drugs kathleen edwards sam fender and more always been tells the story of a man who becomes a clergyman despite a lack of faith the songs detail his rise fall and eventual redemption while also shining a light to sharply reveal the other characters that populate the world he moves through a limited edition 92 page companion book lousy with ghosts accompanies the album and features 11 works of fiction by craig finn these stories take place in the same universe as the record giving deeper looks at the characters within finn released his first solo album in 2012 with three additional solo lps put forth from 2015 2019 faith in the future we all want the same things and 2019s i need a new war which coalesced into a sign of the times musical trilogy finns fifth album a legacy of rentals was released in 2022 and received universal critical acclaim in 2025 finn debuted the band of forgiveness an accomplished group of minneapolis based musicians who bring a unique musical perspective to finns solo compositions in early 2026 the band of forgiveness toured the uk culminating in a sold out performance at londons esteemed union chapel thats how i remember it is craig finns podcast series launched in 2022 co produced and distributed by talkhouse the podcast series examines the connection between memory and creativity each episode features a discussion between finn and one creator including musicians authors filmmakers and more about the role memory plays in their art these exclusive conversations reveal the different ways each creator synthesizes their remembered life experience to tell stories about themselves and the world we live in podcast guests have included george saunders fred armisen bill hader lucinda williams johnny marr jason isbell duff mckagan adam duritz ben gibbard and many more grab dinner before the show at babygold barbecueor enjoy full service dining inside the club when doors open parking there is rather limited street parking in the area events.name: Save Ferris
events.searchText: save ferris save ferris formed in 1995 save ferris remains one of the most beloved ska punk bands of the 1990s blending high octane energy with ska punk and rock the orange county outfit quickly made a name for itself through energetic house parties and dynamic live shows led by the captivating vocals of frontwoman monique powell without a record label powell managed the band herself during its early days their big break came when legendary kroq dj rodney bingenheimer played their cover of dexys midnight runners rdquo come on eileen the overwhelming listener response landed them in heavy radio rotation and caught the attention of major labels in 1996 after winning a grammy showcase for best unsigned band save ferris signed with epic records they released their debut album it means everything in 1997 featuring rdquo come on eileen alongside original hits the band toured internationally for years before releasing 1999 s modified and eventually going on hiatus in 2003 during the break powell worked as a sought after studio musician contributing vocals for artists like the used and goldfinger however severe health issues culminated in a high risk 2015 spinal surgery that threatened her vocal cords spurred by a promise to her father powell successfully recovered and reformed save ferris with a fresh lineup the revived band returned triumphantly playing massive sold out shows and releasing the 2016 crowdfunded ep checkered past produced by oingo boingo s john avila they followed up with a headlining spot on the 2017 warped tour proving their staying power on stage today save ferris continues to captivate audiences with infectious energy and powell s magnetic stage presence rejecting the label of a simple nostalgia act the band is actively working on their first full length album in over two decades proving their best days are still ahead ticket 35 45 club policies show 6 30pm 9pm doors 5pm 8 30pm seating is first come first served per section venue.name: Delaware River Railroad Excursions (Polar Express Train Ride)

events.searchText: the polar express trip length 1 hr 45 min departure point 38 market st phillipsburg nj 08865 how early should i arrive due to remote parking and the need to take shuttles we strongly suggest you are at least 40 minutes early all trips sell out we cannot seat you on a later train what happens on the train the train is beautifully decorated and you will enjoy the story of the polar express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather no refunds no peanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discounts how do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we also recommend having at least 2 dates times ready in case your first choice is sold out seating info single level seats do not flip double decker downstairs please buy in pairs of 2 delaware river railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us
