events.searchText: the polar express trip length 1 hr 45 mindeparture point 38 market st phillipsburg nj 08865how early should i arrive due to remote parking and the need to take shuttles we strongly suggest you are at least 40 minutes early all trips sell out we cannot seat you on a later train what happens on the train the train is beautifully decorated and you will enjoy the story of the polar express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather norefunds nopeanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discountshow do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we also recommend having at least 2 dates times ready in case your first choice is sold out seating info single level seats do not flipdouble decker downstairs please buy in pairs of 2 delaware river railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us

events.name: The Polar Express

venue.name: Delaware River Railroad Excursions (Polar Express Train Ride)

events.searchText: the polar express trip length 1 hr 45 mindeparture point 38 market st phillipsburg nj 08865how early should i arrive due to remote parking and the need to take shuttles we strongly suggest you are at least 40 minutes early all trips sell out we cannot seat you on a later train what happens on the train the train is beautifully decorated and you will enjoy the story of the polar express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather norefunds nopeanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discountshow do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we also recommend having at least 2 dates times ready in case your first choice is sold out seating info single level seats do not flipdouble decker downstairs please buy in pairs of 2 delaware river railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us

events.name: The Polar Express

venue.name: Delaware River Railroad Excursions (Polar Express Train Ride)

events.searchText: the polar express trip length 1 hr 45 mindeparture point 38 market st phillipsburg nj 08865how early should i arrive due to remote parking and the need to take shuttles we strongly suggest you are at least 40 minutes early all trips sell out we cannot seat you on a later train what happens on the train the train is beautifully decorated and you will enjoy the story of the polar express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather norefunds nopeanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discountshow do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we also recommend having at least 2 dates times ready in case your first choice is sold out seating info single level seats do not flipdouble decker downstairs please buy in pairs of 2 delaware river railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us

suggest you are at least 40 minutes early all trips sell out we cannot seat you on a later train what happens on the train the train is beautifully decorated and you will enjoy the story of the polar express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather norefunds nopeanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discountshow do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us

express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather norefunds nopeanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discountshow do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we also recommend having at least 2 dates times ready in case your first choice is sold out seating info single level seats do not flipdouble decker downstairs please buy in pairs of 2 delaware river railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us

the group has produced 13 cds and won numerous music awards their latest cd meant to be was released on october 31 2020 to commemorate their 35th anniversary and was nominated as a finalist for the 2015 hookena was invited to sing and arrange backup vocals for country music star josh turner the song my hawaiian girl was written by turner for his latest cd deep south and was released in march 2017 in may 2021 they were asked again by josh to sing on an island christmas song entitled mele kalikimaka my ohana that he penned and released in december 2021 whether playing for thousands of venue.name: Delaware River Railroad Excursions (Polar Express Train Ride)

events.searchText: the polar express trip length 1 hr 45 mindeparture point 38 market st phillipsburg nj 08865how early should i arrive due to remote parking and the need to take shuttles we strongly suggest you are at least 40 minutes early all trips sell out we cannot seat you on a later train what happens on the train the train is beautifully decorated and you will enjoy the story of the polar express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather norefunds nopeanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discountshow do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we also recommend having at least 2 dates times ready in case your first choice is sold out seating info single level seats do not flipdouble decker downstairs please buy in pairs of 2 delaware river railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us

events.name: The Polar Express

venue.name: Delaware River Railroad Excursions (Polar Express Train Ride)

events.searchText: the polar express trip length 1 hr 45 mindeparture point 38 market st phillipsburg nj 08865how early should i arrive due to remote parking and the need to take shuttles we strongly suggest you are at least 40 minutes early all trips sell out we cannot seat you on a later train what happens on the train the train is beautifully decorated and you will enjoy the story of the polar express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather norefunds nopeanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discountshow do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we also recommend having at least 2 dates times ready in case your first choice is sold out seating info single level seats do not flipdouble decker downstairs please buy in pairs of 2 delaware river railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us

events.searchText: rockfit sleigh sweat rockfit is more than just a workout it s a recurring community experience designed to bring san antonio together through movement health and connection from high energy fitness classes to mindful wellness fairs we re transforming the rock into the ultimate destination for your fitness journey celebrating health at every level finish the year strong and sleigh your 2026 fitness goals join us this december for rockfit sleigh amp sweat a free energizing morning of movement designed to keep you motivated through the holiday season whether you re looking to crush a final fitness milestone or simply stay active amidst the holidays this event delivers a high impact fun workout experience for all fitness levels designed for every body and fitness level our high caliber december lineup features dynamic workout sessions led by professional trainers from local san antonio fitness professionals while this event classes and fair are free and open to all fitness levels a ticket is required space is limited claim your free ticket today to join the rockfit community event details when december 12 8am 1pm event check in 8am where frost plaza at the rock at la cantera 1 spurs way what to know entry and parking to rockfit is free for all ages and fitness level this is an outdoor event rain or shine outside food and beverages are not permitted guests can enhance their experience by joining us at roca amp martillo from 10am 1pm for a special 3 course brunch only 25 that includes a complimentary mimosa for guests ages 21 brunch is not included with your free ticket however show this ticket to your server to redeem this special brunch offer valid only on september 12 2026 the rock at la cantera san antonio tx us

venue.name: Delaware River Railroad Excursions (Polar Express Train Ride)

events.searchText: the polar express trip length 1 hr 45 mindeparture point 38 market st phillipsburg nj 08865how early should i arrive due to remote parking and the need to take shuttles we strongly suggest you are at least 40 minutes early all trips sell out we cannot seat you on a later train what happens on the train the train is beautifully decorated and you will enjoy the story of the polar express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather norefunds nopeanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discountshow do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we also recommend having at least 2 dates times ready in case your first choice is sold out seating info single level seats do not flipdouble decker downstairs please buy in pairs of 2 delaware river railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us

events.searchText: the polar express trip length 1 hr 45 mindeparture point 38 market st phillipsburg nj 08865how early should i arrive due to remote parking and the need to take shuttles we strongly suggest you are at least 40 minutes early all trips sell out we cannot seat you on a later train what happens on the train the train is beautifully decorated and you will enjoy the story of the polar express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather norefunds nopeanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discountshow do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us

events.name: Magnolia Boulevard w/ Madison Hughes
events.searchText: magnolia boulevard w madison hughes doors 7pm show 8pm 15 adv 20 dos21 with a southern rock tinged flavor of soulful americana and a powerful female vocalist reminiscent of tedeschi trucks band magnolia boulevard has blossomed through devastation since forming in 2017 they pushed through the turmoil of covid 19 that devastated the music industry the sorrow following the death of their beloved drummer and the joys of welcoming maggies daughter into the world much like the band members of magnolia boulevard have endured the highs and lows of the past few years so has their music the bands emphatic and empowering anthems of love self discovery grief and uncertainty serve as a lesson to us all about lifes unpredictable nature and how to better live in the moment so we can appreciate everything and everyone around us before theyre gone if patience is a virtue then the current state of magnolia boulevard plays right into the long held notion that sonic grandeur evolves in its own time and place one where the lexington kentucky rock n soul act is aiming to break into a national audience ready and roaring for the quintets soaring talents formed in 2017 by noelle and allen the band came together when other creative endeavors werent fulfilling the artistic desires and professional expectations of what the duo were envisioning it was time to push down the gas pedal on the possibility and potential of what magnolia boulevard could be and ultimately has become in sonic design and in the live realm the sound has been described as appalachian soul and i really like that because of our appalachian roots noelle says you get a taste of folk with the songwriting portion but you also have that rock and soul foundation madison hughes will make you feel like someone finally said the thing out loud not loudly she doesnt need to be her voice carries the kind of weight that sneaks up on you warm and unhurried until a single line stops you mid drive and you sit in the parking lot a little longer than you planned she grew up in ponte vedra beach florida idyllic by every measure rooted in the same coastal southern soil that gave the world lynyrd skynyrd tom petty the allman brothers tedeschi trucks band and ray charles music was in the air before it was ever a choice her fathers folk rock records springsteen jackson browne bonnie raitt sheryl crow gillian welch her mothers soft devastation dido sarah mclachlan the cranberries norah jones the grit and the tenderness both took root she started writing songs in high school because heartbreak cracked her open and she couldnt say the hard things any other way that instinct never left her sound refuses to sit still grunge folk grit threaded through country soul blues pop hooks bleeding into indie americana all of it held together by feel rather than formula in high school she was the girl who sat with everyone at lunch allergic to the idea that you had to pick a side thats still who she is the genre crossing isnt a strategy its just her nature club cafe pittsburgh pa us

events.name: The Polar Express

venue.name: Delaware River Railroad Excursions (Polar Express Train Ride)

events.searchText: the polar express trip length 1 hr 45 mindeparture point 38 market st phillipsburg nj 08865how early should i arrive due to remote parking and the need to take shuttles we strongly suggest you are at least 40 minutes early all trips sell out we cannot seat you on a later train what happens on the train the train is beautifully decorated and you will enjoy the story of the polar express read very audibly over our speaker system all choreographed with the polar express music from the movie hot chocolate and cookies are served santa boards the train and visits the children along with his elves and each child receives a bell from santa can we take pictures with santa yes of course are trips cancelled due to weather norefunds nopeanuts it must be assumed that the cookies have or have been made in a factory that contains nuts hot chocolate the hot chocolate we use is swiss miss please contact them with content inquiries groups to sit together you must be early all together and in the front of the line additionally you must purchase your tickets together and board together to sit together also once you get to the station and get your tickets make sure the group leader informs one of the station platform attendants that your group is here and the number of people in your group so we can help you all board group discounts there are no group discountshow do we get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we cannot exchange your tickets for another trip please make sure when you enter the dates and times that they are correct and check with family beforehand to make sure there are no schedule conflicts we also recommend having at least 2 dates times ready in case your first choice is sold out seating info single level seats do not flipdouble decker downstairs please buy in pairs of 2 delaware river railroad excursions polar express train ride phillipsburg nj us

get our tickets we do not mail tickets please bring your emailed receipt to the ticket office the day of the trip to retrieve your tickets baby seats are not allowed on the train lap sitters a lap sitter is under 2 years of age and must sit on your lap for the entire trip intended for infants only only 1 lap sitter per adult ticket allowed exchanges due to the fact that each trip sells out we events.name: Dazzling Nights® Orlando
events.searchText: dazzling nights orlando experience our community s annual holiday tradition as dazzling nights returns for its 7th season way more than a light show your dazzling nights journey immerses you in the wonder of the holidays through world class live music a brand new high energy dance show immersive worlds interactive light experiences fun play areas fantastic food and beverage and so much more make memories that last a lifetime as you explore the 50 acre harry p leu gardens welcoming you to brand new and expanded holiday worlds shop sip and eat while you enjoy a new light show at the twinkle market dance the night away under reflective disco balls hanging from the treetops experience the music of the holidays in front of a 50 foot snowman in the rose garden enjoy an acrobatic dance performance in the wintry driftlands spin through swirling snow and play among towering yetis in the crystal kingdom journey through a forest of choreographed christmas trees at polar nights stroll through the beauty of the poinsettia promenade a 60 ft long immersive tunnel of illuminated poinsettias race a friend in the yeti mine adventure obstacle course step into a magical meadow alive with illuminated forest creatures like deer foxes and bears experience the chilly celebration with a giant mural of tens of thousands of points of light and our yeti scavenger hunt returns so find them all along your adventure all of this plus the beauty of leu gardens decorated with light plan your visit pick up a dazzling package and enjoy all that dazzling nights has to offer events.name: WAR
events.searchText: war new year s celebration94 7 kumu presents war new year s celebration chicano funk icons war rolled their way to fame in the early 70s with classic hits like low rider and why can t we be friends and they ve kept fans dancing ever since with their groovy socially conscious jams the group s roster has changed over the years but founding member leroy lonnie jordan has remained a constant and his familiar voice and jazzy keyboard licks continue to drive the band s fun loving sets their first single spill the wine was a top 3 hit on billboard s hot 100 making them stars overnight and leading to extensive touring war was quickly hailed as one of the best live bands in the business war dominated the r b charts in the 70s with a string of no 1 albums including the world is a ghetto 1972 deliver the word 1973 and why can t we be friends 1975 the band remaines a funk force to be reckoned with tickets 60 80 club policies 12 30 show 6 30pm doors 5pm 12 30 show 9pm doors 8 30pm 12 31 show 7pm doors 5pm 12 31 show 10pm doors 9pm seating is first come first served per section 20 minimum per person full bar dinner menu available no refunds or exchanges tickets will be delivered 48 hours prior to the showtime please ensure you purchase tickets for the correct date and time when all available bar seats are occupied the remaining bar area is standing room only table seating is all ages bar area is 21 important note we are not affiliated with any third party ticket sellers tickets purchased directly through our official website or ticketweb are the only authorized sources group reservations groups of 6 or more that want to sit together must purchase a group package at events bluenotehawaii com parking validated parking available at outrigger paradise entrance located on kuhio ave 6 for up to 4 hours of parking blue note hawaii honolulu hi us

immerses you in the wonder of the holidays through world class live music a brand new high energy dance show immersive worlds interactive light experiences fun play areas fantastic food and beverage and so much more make memories that last a lifetime as you explore the 50 acre harry p leu gardens welcoming you to brand new and expanded holiday worlds shop sip and eat while you enjoy a new light show at the twinkle market dance the night away under reflective disco balls hanging from the treetops experience the music of the holidays in front of a 50 foot snowman in the rose garden enjoy an acrobatic dance performance in the wintry driftlands spin through swirling snow and play among towering yetis in the crystal kingdom journey through a forest of choreographed christmas trees at polar nights stroll through the beauty of the poinsettia promenade a 60 ft long immersive tunnel of illuminated poinsettias race a friend in the yeti mine adventure obstacle course step into a magical meadow alive with illuminated forest creatures like deer foxes and bears experience the chilly celebration with a giant mural of tens of thousands of points of light and our yeti scavenger hunt returns so find them all along your adventure all of this plus the beauty of leu gardens decorated with light plan your visit pick up a dazzling package and enjoy all that dazzling nights has to offer or select individual tickets select your date and time for all ticket options and details dazzling packages bundle and save 10 on your visit to dazzling nights family 4 pack includes 2 adult 2 child tickets 4 beverages with led cups 4 snacks 2 merchandise options and a souvenir photo adult 2 pack includes 2 adult tickets 4 beverages 2 with an led cup 2 snacks and a souvenir photo individual adult includes 1 adult ticket 2 beverages 1 with an led cup and a snack individual child includes 1 child ticket 1 beverage with an led cup 1 snack and 1 merchandise option or choose individual tickets for adults and kids group tickets available for groups of 10 or more parking all tickets include complementary off site shuttle parking hop aboard the sparkling express and arrive at the garden in no time if you d like to park on site a limited number of on site valet tickets are available on site parking sells out early in the season get your tickets now and join us for the 7th season of dazzling nights orlando harry p leu gardens orlando fl us dazzling nights orlando

events.searchText: david nihill taking tangents tourblue note comedy seriesdavid nihill taking tangents tourafter a sold out world tour comedian and author david nihill is back with his brand new show taking tangents which promises to do exactly that leaving dublin ireland where he was born and raised until the age of 22 david got drunk on travel and never quite hit sobriety of it he has lived and worked in twelve countries and visited over eighty his shows draw on his wide travels cultural observations attempts at language study occasional international drinking session s and being a mildly confused immigrant david is the winner of the prestigious annual san francisco comedy competition previous finalists include robin williams ellen degeneres and dana carvey and runner up in the moths largest us grandslam storytelling competition also a bestselling writer david recorded his debut special documented for dry bar comedy in 2019 his follow up cultural appreciation in 202 and his award winning show shelf help in 2025 he has been featured on ted com sirius xm just for laughs netflix is a joke festival rtes late late show the irish independent inc npr and the huffington post among events.searchText: boots biel join lauren biel for a one of a kind night of books dancing shopping and fun whether youre a seasoned dancer or have never stepped onto the dance floor before our beginner friendly line dance instruction will have you learning new moves and dancing with confidence in no time no experience required just come ready to have fun this isnt your typical author signing while exclusive lauren biel books will be available for preorder and event pickup all books will be pre signed and will not be sold at the event the goal of the evening isnt to spend time waiting in a signing line its to create an experience where readers can relax connect dance laugh and genuinely spend time together a professional photographer will also be on site throughout the event giving attendees opportunities to capture photos with lauren and friends while making memories together looking to upgrade your style visit the hat bar to create a custom hat or add leather branding to a hat you already own additional purchase required enjoy specialty drinks at the cash bar mingle with fellow readers and dancers shop with a featured bookish vendor and participate in games throughout the evening for chances to win fun prizes every ticket holder gets a special signed event memorabielia keychain whether youre coming for the books the dancing the shopping or simply a unique night out this event is all about bringing readers together for an unforgettable experience come ready to laugh connect make memories and enjoy an evening with lauren biel beyond the pages books must be ordered ahead of time with a deadline of 4 1 2027 order here https pci jotform com form 261527865643163 if you do not have a ticket to the event your book order will be cancelled limited ticket quantities no sales at the doorminimum age all attendees must be 18 id required parking is street parking only uber lyft available locallydress code wear whatever makes you comfortable boots and hats are encouraged but not required show off your best purple attire tickets are non refundable but can be transferred in limited circumstances please reach out for assistance middle ages music hall syracuse ny us
